summary: First-principles design review, iteration 6 (full record in review_loop/scrutiny_06.md). The headline finding: iteration 5's completeness contract ('the eval record counts what the arm produced') was enforced at the eval layer but violated ONE LAYER UP, at the predictions producer, in the pro-treatment direction — and the real pilot artifacts confirm it on 5 of 10 instances (e.g. sympy-18189: 5 trajectories produced, only 2 prediction rows). The treatment driver recorded only completed trajectories with non-empty patches, while the vanilla resample driver records an empty-patch row for every resample including failures; a treatment trajectory that failed or made no edits therefore vanished from the treatment's metric-time k while vanilla's unproductive draws counted against it. Quantified bias (M1): at the pilot's worst case the comparison becomes pass@2(2,1)=1.0 vs pass@2(5,1)=0.4 — a +0.6 manufactured headline gain where the truth is a tie at matched k=5; H1's rarefied-distinct comparison inherits the same direction. Three companion defects: a patch captured on a status='failed' trajectory was silently DISCARDED at collection (real, possibly passing treatment patches lost — R7.2 data loss); iteration 5's nonempty_patch_fraction productivity diagnostic was structurally inert for the treatment arm (its empty draws never reached the artifact the diagnostic reads); and the metric loaders kept last-occurrence-per-tid across ALL run batches, so a branching re-run producing FEWER clusters left the prior run's orphan rows in the diversity pool (the eval driver correctly scores only the last primary-delimited batch — the loaders now mirror it). All fixed at the producer per the artifacts-truthful-at-source principle: phased_orchestrator.collect_patch_entries (one patch entry per genuine draw — completed OR failed, patch normalized to '', active/branched excluded with rationale), run_branching.build_predictions (one prediction row per draw including empty; best-of over non-empty only), batch-aware load_predictions_by_tid, and a resample-driver warning when treatment metadata patch entries disagree with total_trajectories (old-driver or interrupted artifact). One new disclosed risk, instrumented not patched (M4/threat 11): in the pilot the entropy signal SATURATED — every instance's 5 proposals clustered all-singleton (entropy = ln5, the grid maximum), making the tau gate degenerate (always-branch below 1.6094). If the real runs reproduce this the gate is reported as uninformative at this substrate/threshold — a publishable negative finding — with an explicit pre-committed rule that retuning the entailment threshold or tau after seeing saturation creates a new exploratory cell, never a quiet recalibration of the confirmatory one. Spec amendment applied under ratchet v2 (applied_06_predictions_record_completeness.md, channel-1 correction derivable from R4.1's own completeness requirement): R7.2 extended with predictions-record completeness, batch-aware loader rule, and the matched-k metadata warning; tripwire check passes — nothing flips to pass (the pilot artifacts become MORE explicitly non-compliant and the removed bias favored the treatment, so the evidence bar rose). 82 tests pass (was 77; +5 covering every new behavior), py_compile clean, compute_metrics/tau_sweep re-run end-to-end on real artifacts. Because substantive evidence-pipeline flaws were again found and fixed, gold_standard_met is FALSE per the charter; the loop should pass once more over the post-fix producers (mocked end-to-end instance through collect_patch_entries/build_predictions, and SDLG-arm child-status flow through the new draw accounting).

issues_found.title: Treatment arm did not record its own unproductive draws (failed/patchless trajectories dropped from predictions) while the vanilla driver records every resample — pro-treatment k deflation at metric time on both H1 and H2, confirmed on 5/10 real pilot instances
issues_found.rationale: Worked example at the pilot's worst case: pass@2(2,1)=1.0 vs pass@2(5,1)=0.4, a +0.6 manufactured gain where truth is a tie at matched k=5. Fixed at the producer: collect_patch_entries + build_predictions write one row per genuine draw (empty patch for unproductive ones), matching the control's convention; R7.2 amended; 3 new stage tests.

issues_found.title: Silent data loss: a patch captured by _capture_patch_if_missing on a trajectory later marked 'failed' was discarded at collection
issues_found.rationale: A real, possibly passing treatment patch could vanish (this direction hurts the treatment — both directions now closed). collect_patch_entries includes failed draws with whatever patch was captured.

issues_found.title: Stale-orphan prediction rows on shrinking branching re-runs: metric loaders kept last-per-tid across ALL run batches while the eval driver scores only the last primary-delimited batch
issues_found.rationale: A re-run with fewer clusters left the old run's t0_strategy_N patch in the diversity pool, inflating n, the rarefaction denominator, and the pairwise-distance set with a patch the eval record never scores. load_predictions_by_tid now batch-splits exactly like load_latest_trajectories (tested).

issues_found.title: Iteration 5's nonempty_patch_fraction productivity diagnostic was structurally inert for the treatment arm (its empty draws never reached the predictions artifact)
issues_found.rationale: Consequence of the producer defect: the instrument added to catch the H1 productivity confound could not fire on the arm where the confound favored the result. Truthful in both arms post-fix; disclosed in RESULTS SS3.

issues_found.title: Entropy signal saturated in the pilot: all instances clustered all-singleton (entropy = ln5, grid maximum), making the tau gate degenerate (always-branch below 1.6094)
issues_found.rationale: Instrumented and disclosed, not patched: the tau sweep already exposes per-instance partitions; RESULTS threat 11 pre-commits the reading rule (if saturation replicates, the gate is reported as uninformative at this substrate — a negative finding; any retuned entailment threshold/tau is a new exploratory cell). Retuning now, pre-data, to make the gate 'do something' would be gate engineering toward the title claim.

issues_found.title: Matched-k driver could silently consume an old-driver or interrupted treatment artifact whose patch entries disagree with total_trajectories
issues_found.rationale: discover_instances_and_k now warns loudly on the mismatch (k source unchanged: total_trajectories); the existing pilot artifacts trigger it mechanically, enforcing their smoke-only status.

changes_made.why: Symmetry with the vanilla resample driver's empty-row-on-failure convention — removes the pro-treatment metric-time k deflation.
